goal: Allow external wallets and scripts to manually lock block heights from being pruned while unloaded
Prevent pruned nodes from deleting blocks needed later to rescan a temporarily unloaded wallet
agreement: Concept support because it enables external wallets to build on pruned nodes via RPC (stickies-v)
Interface objection resolved by returning an object instead of array for extensibility (luke-jr)
Concurrency concern resolved by copying prune locks to avoid data races (sedited)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because external wallets currently lack an explicit RPC to lock block heights during rescan
Avoids requiring external systems to reimplement full manual pruning management via workarounds
